| # Parameter configuration in easyConfig {#parameter-configuration-in-easyconfig-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                                                                                |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This topic explains the configuration of relevant parameters for the InputOutputControlByIdentifier in easyConfig.

Note:

1)Apart from the IOCBI service selection, session reference configuration, and IOCBI-related parameters (callbacks), other parameters are similar to the DID configuration in easyConfig, which are not intended for IO control. For further configuration details and a GUI overview, refer to the easyConfig manual.

2)The default endianness configured for the DID signals is big endian (Motorola) format.

1.IOCBI Enabled/Disabled

  ---------------- --------------- -------- ---------------------- -------------------- ------------------------------------
  Parameter Name   Default Value   Range    Description            Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  IOCBI Enabled    No              Yes/No   Enable/disable IOCBI   Yes                  Once set to YES, IOCBI is enabled.
  ---------------- --------------- -------- ---------------------- -------------------- ------------------------------------

## DID Configuration {#did-configuration .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ---------------- --------------- -------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------
  Parameter Name   Default Value   Range                            Description                                                   Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks

  ---------------- --------------- -------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------

+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ![Attention](attention.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.7083in;border:none"} | •Upon Selection of parameter 1 (IOCBI Enabled/Disabled) user shall be able to configure IOCBI DIDs in the first place.                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                          | •Upon Selection of parameter 4 (Session Refs) as above, user shall be able to configure a DID as Input/Output control related, and only upon its selection parameters 10, 11, 12, 13 will be visible in easyConfig and are configurable. |
|                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                          | •On how to interpret the \"SessionRefs\":\                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                          | DcmDspDidInfo\_\<IOCBI\>\_Parameter\_\<Session\>\_\<Mask\>:\                                                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                          | \<IOCBI\> - meant for IOCBI DID configuration\                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                          | \<Session\> - UDS Session\                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                          | \<Mask\> - Number of bytes of Control Mask                                                                                                                                                                                               |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

## 10. DataResetToDefault Fnc {#dataresettodefault-fnc .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ------------------------ --------------- ------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------
  Parameter Name           Default Value   Range   Description                                                                                                    Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  DataResetToDefault Fnc   \-              \-      Callback for requesting to reset the input/output signal referenced by the Data Identifier to default value.   Yes                  Configurable only if SessionRef is configured related to IOCBI.
  ------------------------ --------------- ------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------

## 11. ReturnControlToECU Fnc {#returncontroltoecu-fnc .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ------------------------ --------------- ------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------
  Parameter Name           Default Value   Range   Description                                                                                                                                   Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  ReturnControlToECU Fnc   \-              \-      Callback to indicate the server (RC) that the client no longer has control about the input/output signal referenced by the Data Identifier.   Yes                  Configurable only if SessionRef is configured related to IOCBI.
  ------------------------ --------------- ------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------

 

12\. ShortTermAdjustment Fnc

  ------------------------- --------------- ------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------
  Parameter Name            Default Value   Range   Description                                                                                                                                                                                    Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  ShortTermAdjustment Fnc   \-              \-      Callback to indicate the server (RC) that it is requested to adjust the input/output signal(s). The IO signal in ASW, represented by the selected DID, is overwritten by the provided value.   Yes                  Configurable only if SessionRef is configured related to IOCBI.
  ------------------------- --------------- ------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------
